actions.action: Water the plant if wilting is due to lack of water
Increase humidity around the leaves (without wetting the leaves)
Wait until evening to see if the wilted plant firms up once the heat dissipates
If the plant does not recover by evening, assess and correct under- or overwatering
Flush the soil with water to wash out excess fertilizer salts
